==Notes==
{{bug|The effects of this skill apply to all spells, regardless of target or attribute.}}
* It takes 6s to recover from 2 points of overcast. If you cast more than three spells while under the effect of this enchantment, you will not be able to completely recover from this skill’s overcast during its recharge.
** If you are concerned about building up too much overcast, consider a lower attribute investment and shorter enchantment duration. Only use the spells that really need the reduced casting time and recharge time while enchanted by Iron Mist. Cast your other spells when this enchantment has worn off. Non-spell skills can be activated any time.
** If you only care about the reduced recharge time, consider using [[Glyph of Swiftness]] instead.
* The overcast caused by this skill is not increased by [[Equinox]], and not prevented by [[Glyph of Energy]].
* The overcast caused by casting a spell is applied in time to trigger that spell’s additional effects.

==Trivia==
